create_IPythonVisualization: create an IPythonVisualization dataclass to replace a subtree with a rendered display object
create_VisualizationFromTreescopePart: create a VisualizationFromTreescopePart to directly insert custom Treescope rendering content
create_ChildAutovisualizer: create a ChildAutovisualizer to switch to a different autovisualizer while rendering children
define_Autovisualizer: define an Autovisualizer protocol to customize Treescope rendering of PyTree subtrees
set_active_autovisualizer: set the active_autovisualizer contextual value to enable automatic subtree visualization
